claims.statement: Project Practical reports that Glossier uses user-generated content and collaborates with influencers.
claims.quote: By incorporating user-generated content, Glossier encourages customers to become brand advocates

claims.statement: Glossier has a large Instagram following.
claims.quote: A community of over 2.8 million followers (2024) engages with carousels, UGC spotlights, and routine breakdowns

brand_summary: Glossier prioritizes skincare over makeup {C1}. Third-party marketing analyses describe a community-driven strategy {C2} built on user-generated content and influencer partnerships {C3}, and report an Instagram community of over 2.8 million followers {C4}.
current_marketing_strategy: Marketing blogs report a community-driven strategy built on user-generated content and influencer partnerships {C2}{C3}.

collaboration_opportunities: Collaborate on a new Instagram carousel featuring user-generated content that highlights the skincare-first approach of Glossier products {C1}{C3}

instagram_post_idea.hook: A carousel featuring user-generated content that showcases the skincare-first approach of Glossier products
instagram_post_idea.concept: A carousel of real customers' skin-first routines, each slide credited to the person who shared it
instagram_post_idea.why_it_fits: This post aligns with Glossier's focus on skincare and community engagement {C1}{C2}

email_subject: Collaborate on a new Instagram carousel featuring user-generated content
email_body:
Dear Glossier Marketing Team,

We propose collaborating on a new Instagram carousel that features user-generated content highlighting the skincare-first approach of Glossier products. This aligns with your focus on skincare and community engagement {C1}{C2}. The carousel would feature real customers' skin-first routines, shared with their permission.

If this sounds interesting, we'd be happy to share a draft.

Best regards,
[Your Team]
